verdicts.reason: The two share the same faults. The translucent column has broken into an orphaned grey rectangle and a stray strip near the bottom, the two chevron groups have merged into one tangled row on the busy city image, and the subhead sits straight on the photo. A is worse: its eyebrow is stacked into three lines beside 'London', and the subhead wraps into four ragged lines. B keeps a tidier two-line eyebrow above the headline and a two-line subhead, so it has slightly better hierarchy and typography.
